column1: # pc-011 and pc-012 declare answers of more than one symbol, which is what `--retrieval-only`
# scores anchor coverage over. OwnerController's seven mappings are the whole of its HTTP
# surface at this commit, so pc-011 is exhaustive; pc-012 lists the three classes that declare
# an OwnerRepository field and is not, because the impact of a repository reaches further.
# pc-013 onwards deliberately do NOT name their subject. Every earlier question says "what breaks
# if VetRepository changes", which the exact-name signal settles before any card text is read -
# which is why retrieval saturates at 1.000 here and why branch summaries could not be shown to
# help. These ask the way someone who does not yet know the symbol's name would ask.
